audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 5 and 6 read Skill on both layers, but whys[5] says your range and item poke outscale his stacks (that is a Ziggs row) and whys[6], late and spikes[3] all say a stacked Nasus deletes you (that is a Nasus row). packet.levelChart reads Ziggs for row 5 and Nasus for row 6.
audit.why: The page currently renders 'Skill' over prose that names a winner in both directions. Nasus is the one lane on this list that genuinely inverts: you own levels 1-6 on range, he owns the late game once Siphoning Strike is stacked.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side + win[5] to Ziggs (rating 4/10 -> 6/10); phases[6].side + win[6] to Nasus (rating 5/10 -> 3/10). Proposed as one atomic group of matched pairs. Rows 0-4 stand as Ziggs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fury of the Sands was described only as 'bonus health and AoE burn'. No cooldown, no aura range, and no mention that it also grants armour and magic resist.
audit.why: It is 120/100/80s with a 400-range aura and it grants bonus Armor and Magic Resistance on top of the health — that is why trying to out-tank it does not work, and why the answer is simply standing outside 400. His Siphoning Strike cooldown also drops while it is up.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now carries the 120s timer, the 400 aura, the resist gain and the 700 Wither threshold.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] said Wither is used 'to close the gap'. Wither is not a gap-closer — it is a 700-range decay on Move and Attack Speed. dontsFull[0].d was filler ('decline politely and watch it retire') with no mechanic in it.
audit.why: The distinction matters to how you play the row: Nasus never closes distance himself, he removes yours. Your Q is 850, his Wither 700, Siphoning Strike 255, Spirit Fire 650, Fury of the Sands 400 — every number in his kit is shorter than yours, so the whole lane is one spacing rule.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] restated as the speed strip from 700; dontsFull[0].d now carries the 700-vs-850 comparison.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names Wither as the thing to track repeatedly and never once states its cooldown, and never states Satchel Charge's either.
audit.why: Wither is 15/14/13/12/11s and Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s. At rank 1 his answer comes back five seconds before yours, which is exactly why you bait Wither before you ever commit.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries 15s/11s for Wither and 20s for Satchel Charge.

audit.why: packet.defects flags 'Farm Siphoning Strike' in wants.foe[0] as a probable wrong name. Siphoning Strike is the correct name of Nasus's Q.
